interpretation: Both reviewed implementations passed the tested contracts and accepted preview through a bounded shared-handler change. Carbon rated both changes local; coordinator source verification supports that ruling. Both initial implementations converged to inline phases, so this does not compare a pre-existing planning helper with inline code or establish a draft-version/skill advantage.
remainingObservations: Path a02/b02 retains pre-existing extra rows output and a redundant raw email value in its contact-map entries; these are not introduced by the extension.
Own tests differ in explicit transient-mutation protection; the independent suite checks attempted writes and transient contact mutation for both.
Carbon normalization wording is slightly imprecise: findByEmail and insert normalize keys; rename locates by id and only updates name. The verified locality argument relies on that actual behavior.
